note: At the base of the St. Mary dam in a river oxbow ~5 km NW of Magrath, beside the Lower day-use area (playground, picnic shelter, basketball half-court); mature trees, and the sites on the river side of the outer loop (about 14-24) back onto the St. Mary River. --Claude
summary: Confirmed from the camping page (updated Jun 5, 2026) and the shop: 1 unserviced C$26 + 35 power 15/30-amp C$30, no water on site, vault toilets; season May 15 - Oct 1 (derived close 10-31 was wrong); reservable May 15 - Sep 30, bookings open Feb 14; shop max vehicle 41-61 ft. Pin on the campground. Riverfront kept with a site-range caveat.
flags: PROVINCIAL PAGE LINES: Information phone 403-394-0150 (stored phone empty; apply.py does not write phones). No 'Facility Operator' line. No seniors-discount line. No advisories. Shop: park-level 'Open year round', no 'Closed through' date shown.
WEBSITE: stored camping page + shop answer 200 and are this campground; keep.

WATERFRONT: keep riverfront. Page: 'Some sites sit right along the water, providing peaceful views and easy shoreline access.' 2014 site map (page 3 of https://www.albertaparks.ca/media/3330318/st-mary-reservoir-map_opt.pdf) puts sites ~14-24 on the river side of the outer road; Esri imagery shows those pad ends ~30-35 m from the St. Mary River channel (~60-65 m wide) across open grass with a marshy fringe; the southern part of the row has shrubs/trees. The shop tags no Lower site Near Water (only the Lower group site). Recommend riverfront with the caveat naming the river-side row (now in the note); the other sites are not waterfront.
PIN: 49.36980,-113.10750 sits on the campground (agency directions point 49.370454,-113.106799, ~80 m); confirmed.
